data.name: New Dark Age
data.detailed_description:
New Dark Age is a near-future war game set in a war-torn Europe.

The game combines two perspectives:
• a young boy trying to survive and document the world around him
• soldiers fighting in large-scale multiplayer battles in the same environments
What is destroyed in combat becomes part of the world the boy must navigate.

________________________________________

Multiplayer
Fight as an ordinary soldier in infantry-focused combat.
• Close-range battles in trenches, ruins, and urban environments
• Limited visibility and heavy reliance on sound
• Slow, tactical movement and decision-making
• No heroes - only survival under pressure
Victory is uncertain. Coordination and survival matter more than kill counts.

________________________________________

Single-player
Experience the war through the eyes of a young boy.
• Explore destroyed environments
• Capture moments through photography
• Record memories shaped by the war around you
A personal perspective on survival and aftermath.

________________________________________

Player-built battlefields
Players shape the battlefield during matches:
• Build trench lines
• Place bunkers and defensive positions
• Create cover and barriers
Battlefields evolve based on player actions, creating shifting frontlines and tactical depth.

________________________________________

Experience
New Dark Age is driven by atmosphere and immersion.
War is communicated through sound, light, space, and silence - not only visuals.
Every encounter carries tension, unpredictability, and emotional weight.
The game combines:
• tactical FPS combat
• systemic battlefield construction
• environmental storytelling through perspective

data.short_description: New Dark Age is a war game set in a fractured near-future Europe, told through two interconnected perspectives - multiplayer combat as ordinary soldiers and a single-player story of a child surviving its aftermath. One war, two realities: the chaos of battle and the silence it leaves behind.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: 1080p / 30 FPS / Low settings. SSD is recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: 1080p / 60 FPS / Epic settings. SSD is recommended.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent depictions of war and violence, including combat with firearms and battlefield environments.

The single-player experience deals with mature themes such as survival, loss, and the psychological impact of war, presented through the perspective of a child navigating its aftermath.
